news.title: Conagra Increases Prices to Cope With Soaring Transportation Costs
news.summary: Food giant Conagra had been planning for higher prices for beef, edible oils and packaging.  Now its inflation rate tied to transportation is doubling.  The maker of Slim Jim meat sticks and Orville Redenbacher’s popcorn on Wednesday pushed its inflation outlook for the current fiscal year to the higher end of its 5% to 6% range.
